description: We are TECHNOTED, an FRC team from TED Hatay College, Türkiye. We are passionate about robotics, engineering, programming, and innovation. With experience in international competitions, we value teamwork, creativity, and continuous learning. We are looking for motivated members interested in programming, mechanical design, CAD, electronics, manufacturing, business, and marketing. You don't need to be an expert; curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to learn are what matter most.
